name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
description: Government of India mission to provide all-weather pucca houses to eligible families in urban areas through interest subsidy, beneficiary-led construction, and affordable housing in partnership.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Financial assistance and interest subsidy up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per eligible household for constructing or purchasing a pucca house under ISS, BLC, AHP, and ARHC verticals.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Central mission addressing urban housing shortages across all statutory towns in India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Families in urban areas belonging to EWS, LIG, and Middle Income Group who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Central assistance and interest subsidy of up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per dwelling unit distributed based on chosen scheme vertical.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Official PMAY-Urban portal and citizen registration hosted on pmay-urban.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: 10th CSMC meeting held on 16 October 2026 approved 1.93 lakh houses, taking cumulative sanctions under PMAY-U 2.0 to 20.80 lakh houses.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
source_evidence.citation: Minutes of the 10th CSMC Meeting, Section 2

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Captures pucca house ownership exclusion and EWS/LIG economic criteria under PMAY-U 2.0.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Aadhaar cards for all family members included in the application.
required_documents.guidance: Ensure names match exactly with bank and property registration records.

required_documents.title: Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Proof of annual family income to verify EWS/LIG/MIG classification.
required_documents.guidance: Must be valid for the current financial year.
